headline: Bills rule out D.J. Moore after WR suffers shoulder injury
summary: DJ Moore was ruled out of Thursday night's game against the Lions because of a shoulder injury.

headline: Eagles' Jalen Carter to wear cast on injured wrist vs. Titans
summary: Eagles defensive tackle Jalen Carter expects to wear a cast on his injured right wrist for Sunday's Week 2 matchup against the Titans.

headline: After a poor 2025 at home, the Ravens try to turn the page when they host New Orleans
summary: Jesse Minter wasn't even with the Ravens last season, but the new coach seems to have a healthy grasp of how 2025 went so badly wrong for Baltimore.

headline: There's sudden urgency for old NFC East rivals as Commanders visit Cowboys following opening losses
summary: — There's a sudden sense of urgency as the Washington Commanders and Dallas Cowboys renew an old NFC East rivalry with both teams staring at an 0-2 start in division games.

headline: Saints' Alvin Kamara practices, 'moving well' after MCL sprain
summary: Saints running back Alvin Kamara has "no limitations," was a full participant in practice and says his knee feels good only one month after spraining his MCL in practice.

headline: Bo Nix, Broncos 'not freaking out' after mistake-filled loss to Chiefs
summary: Denver Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said the mistakes were clear to see from Monday night's loss in Kansas City, but "we're not freaking out'' as the team prepares for Sunday's home opener against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
